notes: All five proposals implemented as nine modules. Deviations: (1) P070 c1 unshorten_preview makes no request: Bitly's ToS forbid robots/screen-scraping (A9) and TinyURL's terms are unrecorded (A1), so preview pages are manual links; the preview parsers are ready and tested on synthetic pages (backlog). (2) P070 c4 uses the core redirect loop with a per-hop hop_check (the core LIGHT seed binding refuses an allow_redirects=False loop across hosts); the core cap is 5 hops (stricter than 10). (3) P063 security_headers cannot read the HTTP cache from a disclosure-'none' module: SKIPPED 'not_applicable' until ctx.cached_response exists (core request); the audit is a tested library. (4) light_fetch now exempts only the exact hosts of an internal analyst-typed seed (RunInfo.internal_seed) from its own internal-name refusal; the core still decides. Live: Wayback reset the connection from the batch egress (favicon_hash/js_endpoints_archive -> ERROR could-not-verify, accepted); unshorten.me live OK; LIGHT modules exercised only against a 127.0.0.1 server. Tests: 141 offline batch tests pass; 12 live tests pass (V3LUM_LIVE=1); registry contract green for the 9 modules; P327 lint clean; ruff clean. Full offline suite: 10 failures, all in other batches' files; rerun once, 5 still fail (test_typosquat::test_bcb_rows_and_dataset_discovery, test_windows_artifact_triage::test_lnk_powershell_dropper, test_engine_suppression::test_breach_and_infostealer_respects_generic_and_third_party_addresses, test_permissions::test_reports_are_never_written_outside_out_dir, test_rule_api::test_legacy_flag_on_the_eight_legacy_rules); reported, not fixed. Review (2026-11-26): fixed (a) js_endpoints c7 false positives - a site's own search/login forms, same-site POSTs and cross-site newsletter forms gave a MEDIUM 'phishing-kit exfiltration' finding tagged 'phishing' and exfil_endpoint pivots on every ordinary page; channels now need Telegram/Discord or a cross-site credential form (kit_channels), the 'phishing' verdict tag is dropped; (b) c4 regex safety - inline_scripts (lazy .{0,262144}? regex, 80 s on 160 KB of unclosed <script>) and the per-form 32 KB window were quadratic on hostile pages: forward-only str.find scan, 200 forms x 16 KB, faster linear classifier, adversarial timing tests; (c) page-derived URLs (refused hrefs/srcs, drop URLs, core refusal texts, hop reasons) stored raw with e-mails/tokens - now masked in attributes and raw; (d) unshorten.me 'Unable to resolve' was EMPTY - now ERROR could-not-verify; (e) wellknown_files ended EMPTY when a sitemap could not be read - sitemap failures now count; (f) favicon_fetch: a homepage redirect off-site gave SKIPPED 'seed not fetched' after contact (safe_get now keeps the redirect status; the seed /favicon.ico is still tried), refused icon candidates/redirects were EMPTY - now SKIPPED policy; (g) unshorten.me terms recorded 'unknown' ('no terms published') though https://unshorten.me/terms-of-service exists and covers company use - source and module terms now 'open' (tier stays unknown); (h) AR21 acceptance route files added for the default modules (favicon_hash, security_headers, unshorten_preview).
